Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Zephyr Fixation System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- a maximum spatial field gradient of 30 T/m (3000 gauss/cm).
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- whole-body averaged SAR of 2 W/kg or less.
- No more than 30 minutes of active scan time per session.
